annual_report_takeaways: FY2025 comparable sales fell 1.7%, with transactions down 2.9% and average check up 1.2%.
FY2025 operating cash flow was $2.114B against $666.3M of capital spending and $2.426B of share repurchases.
Q2 2026 comparable sales rose 2.2%, with transactions up 1.0% and average check up 1.2%.
Q2 2026 restaurant-level margin fell to 25.2% from 27.4%, while food and labor costs rose as percentages of revenue.
Digital sales were 38.3% of Q2 food and beverage revenue, and 80 of 100 new Q2 stores included Chipotlanes.

analysis_stack.operating_model_read: Chipotle owns almost all its restaurants and combines a simple visible-food promise with digital ordering, Chipotlanes, and new-store growth. The main risk is that the cost of serving each customer is rising while existing-store traffic is only beginning to recover.
quarterly_takeaways: Q2 2026 comparable sales rose 2.2%, with transactions up 1.0% and average check up 1.2%.
Q2 2026 restaurant-level margin fell to 25.2% from 27.4%, while food and labor costs rose as percentages of revenue.
Digital sales were 38.3% of Q2 food and beverage revenue, and 80 of 100 new Q2 stores included Chipotlanes.
signal_takeaways: visible food promise: Visibility can reduce uncertainty and support a higher price.
simple menu: A narrower menu may make training and quality control easier.
Chipotlane: Easier pickup can widen the useful reach of one store.
company-owned stores: The parent keeps the store upside and carries the operating downside.
digital ordering: Digital ordering removes some customer effort but can add kitchen and delivery work.
new-store growth: New stores can grow profit if each store earns back its build cost.
strategy_framework_checks: Use when reported earnings and cash available to owners may diverge because of maintenance capex, working capital, or reinvestment burden.
Use when the central question is what operating future is already embedded in the current market narrative.
Use when margins depend on supplier power, customer concentration, substitute products, or competitive intensity.
analysis_stack.valuation_focus: Chipotle has a credible growth engine, but the investment depends on new stores earning strong returns while existing-store traffic and margins recover. The company-owned model makes both the upside and the burden visible in Chipotle's own results.
